site.title: Aileen's Gpose Notes
site.tagline: Notes from experimenting with ReShade and gpose in Final Fantasy XIV.

effects.title: Launchpad
effects.summary: Upstream utility shader: smoothed normals and motion vectors that feed every other physically-based effect.

effects.title: Bloom
effects.summary: Soft glow around bright areas, simulating light scattering in the eye and camera optics.

effects.title: Depth of Field
effects.summary: Photographic background blur that separates your subject from the scene and produces real bokeh.

effects.title: Color Grading
effects.summary: Exposure, contrast, white balance, hue and tone shaping — where a screenshot becomes a look.

effects.title: Clarity
effects.summary: Midtone local-contrast lift — makes flat-lit scenes pop without the halos of heavy sharpening.

effects.title: Sharpen
effects.summary: Local edge contrast boost that recovers detail lost to anti-aliasing, upscaling, or low resolution.

effects.title: SMAA
effects.summary: Post-process anti-aliasing that cleans up jagged edges the game's built-in AA misses.

effects.title: Ambient Occlusion
effects.summary: Soft contact shadows in crevices and where surfaces meet — the cheapest way to kill a flat-looking gpose.

effects.title: RTGI — Diffuse Illumination
effects.summary: Screen-space ray-traced global illumination — the soft bounced fill light the game engine never computes.

effects.title: RTGI — Specular Reflection
effects.summary: Ray-traced glossy reflections graded by surface roughness — puts real shine on metal, stone, and water.
